==Description==
'''E-10''' will be the 1st entity you may encounter in [[Section E]]. More information about this entity is presented below.

==Behavior==
'''E-10''' will appear in front of the exit door while emitting a low-pitched piano chime. After idling for several seconds, '''E-10''' will start rushing backwards as usual, similarly to [[A-85]]. Unlike the latter entity, '''E-10''' will not disappear after it has reached the Voidwall, instead it will stop behind the barrier until the next door is opened or broken down. 

When this action occurs, '''E-10''' will proceed back to the main room. If more doors are either opened/destroyed while the instance is returning, the entity will increase its speed in attempt to catch players off-guard, disappearing once it hits the door which could potentially spawn another entity.

==Strategy & Tips==
* Hide as soon as you see him and wait until he falls back. After it has passed by, you should exit your locker and open the door after around six seconds. Afterwards, you must wait around four seconds before entering a locker.
** If the room's layout from behind is straight, you may take a small peek at '''E-10'''<nowiki/>'s position and check when you can enter a locker again to evade his attack.
* '''E-10'''<nowiki/>'s kill range is very large, large enough to damage you from another room, so ensure to enter your locker when he's nearby while the entity is returning back to the main room. 
** Safe spots that are far enough the entity's kill range or fully opaque are also versatile.

* [https://youtu.be/imXuXeFfPBo?si=x4Btb_lWbZM8gqjU Video Representation]

==Notes==
* '''E-10''' will not make his way back to the main room while [[E-200]] is active, especially if a door was opened/destroyed.

==Trivia==
* '''E-10''' was one of the two invasive entities present during the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]], the other being [[E-60]]. 
* '''E-10''' is a repurposed '''E-17''' From '''Rooms: Found Footage: Revisited''', albeit with altered mechanics.
* '''E-10''' has a joke nickname that is '''Sun''', due to having a very bright light and large light range.
